def paint(n: int, ops: list[list[int]]) -> list[list[int]]:
    m = len(ops)
    size = 1
    while size < m:
        size <<= 1

    max_colour = [0] * (2 * size)
    has_erase = bytearray(2 * size)
    events = []

    for i, op in enumerate(ops):
        events.append((op[1], i, 1))
        events.append((op[2] + 1, i, 0))

    events.sort()
    counts = {}
    previous = events[0][0]
    j = 0

    while j < len(events):
        position = events[j][0]
        colour = max_colour[1]
        if colour:
            counts[colour] = counts.get(colour, 0) + position - previous

        while j < len(events) and events[j][0] == position:
            _, i, active = events[j]
            node = size + i

            if active:
                if ops[i][0] == 0:
                    has_erase[node] = 1
                    max_colour[node] = 0
                else:
                    has_erase[node] = 0
                    max_colour[node] = ops[i][3]
            else:
                has_erase[node] = 0
                max_colour[node] = 0

            node >>= 1
            while node:
                left = node << 1
                right = left | 1
                has_erase[node] = has_erase[left] | has_erase[right]

                if has_erase[right]:
                    max_colour[node] = max_colour[right]
                else:
                    a = max_colour[left]
                    b = max_colour[right]
                    max_colour[node] = a if a > b else b

                node >>= 1

            j += 1

        previous = position

    return [[colour, counts[colour]] for colour in sorted(counts)]
